pedidos.instruccion_en: Edit only the woman on the right ('after' side): give her a slightly curvier silhouette at the hips, thighs and legs, a bit more than now, still natural, proportional and believable for an ordinary woman. Keep the same woman, face, pose, side view, outfit, bench, lighting and background. Do not change the 'before' woman, the bottle, the arrow, the labels, the headline, the bottom strip or any text. No exaggerated or unrealistic proportions, no new focus or zoom on body parts.
pedidos.resumen: Le damos un poco más de curva a caderas y piernas en el «después», sin exagerar. Todo lo demás queda igual.
